important_interpretation: EXP11 does not assign a fictitious exact gate cost to coherent correlation-state preparation. Instead that unknown cost is swept explicitly.
The outer QAA cost includes one initial A call and two A-family calls per Grover iteration, together with one EXP10 marking phase-oracle call per iteration.
EXP09 verifier-retention failures are treated conservatively as zero true-key success.
The marked-sector probability is estimated from P(true)/P(true|marked), using the representative EXP09 robust operating point.
Classical and quantum primitive-work counts are reported separately because Toffoli-equivalent logical cost is not directly comparable with a classical CPU operation count.
limitations: The coherent correlation-state preparation unitary A has not yet been synthesized gate-by-gate.
qRAM or coherent external-memory access remains outside the EXP10/EXP11 cost model.
Surface-code overhead, routing, T-state factories, hardware noise, and physical runtime are not included.
EXP09 statistics are averaged over random validation subsets; EXP11 therefore represents a statistical end-to-end benchmark rather than one fixed compiled oracle instance.
